settings.heading: Kit for rest time, outings and change rooms
settings.text: WonderFold stroller wagons, ZAZU sleep aids, Magic nappy bins and Hannie highchairs, supplied by Coolkidz to early learning centres across Australia.

settings.title: Stroller wagons for outings
settings.text: Wagons that seat two to six children, from the W2 to the W6, with room for bags and supplies.

settings.title: Rest time
settings.text: White noise machines, nightlights and sleep trainer clocks for sleep rooms.

settings.title: Nappy bins
settings.text: Nappy bins that take standard bags, with no refill cartridges to buy.

settings.title: Portable highchair
settings.text: A compact highchair that packs away when you need the space.

settings.title: One supplier for every room
settings.text: One order, one invoice and one help desk across all your brands and centres.

settings.title: Warranty and parts
settings.text: Australian warranty support and spare parts through our help desk.
ZAZU, Magic and Hannie are also on Faire for small orders. WonderFold wagons are ordered through a Coolkidz trade account.
